Horn of Celebration

Internal ID: tankardAnniversary | Type: Tool | Source: Workbench | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Bronze x2, Troll hide x2, Iron x2

Introduction. Horns of Celebration are ornate tankards marking the first anniversary of the release of Valheim. They are used to consume mead from within the inventory. Mead can, however, be consumed without a Horn of Celebration.

Notes. • The word "Skål" in the description is Swedish, Norwegian and Danish for "toast!", or "cheers!".
• The Horn of Celebration first appeared in a Public Test Branch on February 24, 2022.
